acceptanceCriteria: Profiles before and after on the Corvint repo at recorded host load
Index build wall time is reduced by >=20% with byte-identical snapshot content, or the floor is documented with a profile
Any encoding change goes through the benchmark and format gate
body: Lane index-perf-1021i (PR #1458, V1-2239) profiled index build. The os.Root openat walk takes 22% of CPU, GC about 30%, tokenise 13% and goSymbols 8.5%. The gob decode format is itself a floor for snapshot load, even after the mmap path (IDX-SNAP-V0-105). The 10.9 s build figure in V1-2239 did not reproduce. Candidates: a prefix-held directory fd walk, as in journal S6 (open each directory once, then openat the leaf); arena or slab allocation for tokens to cut GC; GOGC tuning for the one-shot build; and a non-gob snapshot encoding behind the format gate (invariant 7).

title: index build: os.Root per-component openat walk (22%) and GC (~30%) dominate index-build CPU
